data_limitations: Fictional raster-rendered UI, not customer or browser recordings.
Layout families disjoint between splits, but renderer infrastructure and event timing are shared.
Conditions are paired correlated variants, not independent population samples.
C changes font size, contrast, compression and background motion together; no single-factor causal claim.
English supported text patterns only. Does not evaluate human efficiency or UGen300.
event_matching: One-to-one type plus >=50% truth box coverage on at least one expected frame. Per-frame recall and independent pixel coverage report partial misses.
mask_coverage: >=99.5% of each annotated region, every RGB channel <=16, on every annotated frame. Original missed regions remain in denominator.

ablation_1hz.method: Replay unchanged per-frame observations at every 1 Hz phase; original temporal track IDs retained only to match events. No separate product implementation or speedup measurement.
ablation_1hz.cache_model: Exact decoded-pixel SHA-256 LRU, capacity 128, empty at clip start; call counts are eligible work, not timings.

rescan.message: Supported text patterns remain. Review kept events and the exported media before sharing.

limitations: Supported visible text patterns only; names, faces and arbitrary confidential content may be missed.
Output rescan uses the same OCR and rules and is not an independent privacy guarantee.
OCR accuracy depends on font, size, contrast, compression and language.
